description: A sealed end-of-semester archive record. Immutable once sealed. Contains a bundleRef pointing to the archived content blob on the Ring. May optionally include an Internet Archive URL after upload.

courseUri.description: AT URI of the app.changala.course being archived.

sealedBy.description: DID of the admin who sealed the archive.

bundleRef.description: Reference to the archive bundle blob on the Ring.

internetArchiveUrl.description: URL on archive.org if the bundle has been uploaded.

sessionCount.description: Number of sessions included in this archive.

noteCount.description: Number of notes included in this archive.

sealedAt.description: Timestamp when the archive was sealed.
